questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
(saved with the handle) the platform they post on most
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the topic title and the spoken item name)?
(saved with the accent colour) the plain word for it: blue, gold, lime
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font: title, tier letters and card names
Captions in the same main font, or a different one?
(found on their computer) the caption font; left unset, the main bold is reused
Transcribe with ElevenLabs (recommended, the most accurate word timings) or on this computer (free)?
Where should finished videos go? Next to the raw file in an '- Edit' folder is the default.
questions.default: beside the raw file, in a "<video name> - Edit" folder

questions.ask: Is your raw footage on an external drive? Which one?
Where do you keep music you are allowed to use?
Should I always ask before adding music, or add a favourite and tell you which?
Where do you keep real things I can show on screen: screenshots, client results, your own reel covers?
Besides your proof folder, other folders to search for a picture that represents each item (full paths; several are fine)
May I fetch real screenshots, logos and photos from the web for the item cards? You decide what you are comfortable publishing; I list every source.
questions.default: yes: real over drawn, every source listed in the report

questions.ask: Anything that must never appear on a card: names, brands, competitors, people?
Topic title style: italic or upright?
Topic title case: all caps or as written?
Colour of the item name printed on each card (outlined in black so it reads on any picture)
Captions on the reel: on or off?
Where may the table go if it would cover the face?
questions.default: safe zone first, then lower into the bottom zone, then 10-20% smaller; always show the option frames and let the creator choose

questions.ask: How far should I go alone: build a preview and report, or stop and check after the plan and after the layout options?
questions.default: build a preview, show the layout options when the table cannot sit in the safe zone, then wait for approval before the final
